Secondly can u define wht is ssatanic dream and wht is the cause or efeect of it Question: Salam,i saw a dream few dyas back.in which i saw the thr was an earth quake .me and my friend were runing out and whn we were just coming out of building it was just falling.but i could not know whether we were saved or we came under the building.What does my dream intpret.Well now tht we came out of it. Secondly can u define wht is ssatanic dream and wht is the cause or efeect of it Answer ID: 9567 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2055/2049=D/1429) Satanic dreams are the ones which one sees in dreams as reflections of thoughts. The Satan wants to annoy and worry. The Hadith instructs that while seeing such dreams one should recite: لاحول و لاقوۃ الا باللہ and divert his attention from it without telling it to anyone. The dreams themselves do not affect, it is not right to decide something as good and bad by mere seeing a dream. However, sometimes dreams are signals from Allah. The abovementioned dream is an indication to destructions caused by sins which are emerging in the society. So, you should see how much you are trying to avoid the destructions of sins, keep on your efforts and fear Allah so that you are protected fully. May Allah keep all of us protected from the destructions of sins! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
